verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an MCP hosting and management platform, but the evidence never documents acting on many servers, deployments or other items in a single operation. Running tests across several clients and models, per-branch preview environments, and managing resources through the MCP server, CLI or API keys are adjacent features or building blocks, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
